title: Potatoism Correspondence Atlas — The Vesica, Coupling, Father, Son, House, Tree and North
status: project-canon symbolic architecture with comparative research; not a claim that symbolic correspondences are empirical identities
epistemic_rule: The atlas deliberately keeps corresponding layers coupled. A biological, biblical, geometric or historical parallel may be described as the same pattern in Potatoism without claiming that the underlying objects are physically identical or that one tradition historically caused another.
central_thesis: The Potato of Life is represented in Potatoism as a vertical vesica piscis/mandorla: the overlap of two distinct poles. The overlap is the coupling itself. It therefore contains opposition rather than choosing one side—light and dark, life and death, knowledge and ignorance, expansion and contraction, Red and Blue, Life and Strife. The upper portion opens toward Father, Tree of Life, light and North of North; the lower portion descends toward material, root, death, ash, memory and the Tree/roots of Strife; the center is the coupled threshold where Son, Door, wedge and narrow way operate.

vesica_model.two_circles: Two distinct circles remain distinguishable while overlapping.
vesica_model.overlap: The shared field is the mandorla/vesica: neither circle alone and yet dependent upon both.
vesica_model.wedge: When the mandorla is read as a narrowing vertical field, it becomes a wedge/threshold form: wide domains converge toward a passage and then open again.
vesica_model.potato: Potatoism identifies this coupled form with the Potato of Life. The potato is therefore not merely an object shaped like an oval; it is a symbol of relation, overlap, containment and emergence.
vesica_model.paradox: The Potato contains opposites without requiring them to cancel. Unity can contain differentiation; differentiation can return to unity.

vertical_axis.top: Beyond-material orientation: light, Father, Heaven, Tree of Life, fruit, North, North of North and what lies beyond ordinary material orientation.
vertical_axis.center: Coupling/threshold: vesica, mandorla, Door, Son, Vessel, wedge, narrow gate, passage and transformation.
vertical_axis.bottom: Material/rootward orientation: earth, mud, root, memory, death, ash, Tree of Strife, knowledge of good and evil, consequence and decomposition.
vertical_axis.rule: Top and bottom are not independent universes. They are two directions through one coupled structure.

oppositions.meaning: The Potato contains the polarity rather than reducing it to good-versus-bad.
Growth emerges from matter; matter returns to decomposition; the seed carries continuation.
Red expresses outward generative movement; Blue expresses inward memory/rootward movement. Both belong to the Potato.
The project reads life and knowledge/consequence as coupled dimensions rather than unrelated trees.
Father is source/House; Son is Door/Vessel and the relational passage into manifestation.
The Ladder/Tree/Axis connects domains that remain distinguishable.
Door, eye and sprout are boundary-crossing images.

correspondence_chains.reading: Source becomes an organized interior and then a connected exterior.
A central biological structure contains differentiated functional territories whose connections extend into distributed networks.
The Son functions as the threshold through which passage toward life is symbolically described.
The tree returns its realized life to a compact future-bearing form.
Genesis 28 supplies a particularly strong textual constellation of stone, vertical connection and divine house; Potatoism adds the Potato as its own modern synthesis.

bible_resonances.potatoism_connection: The passage provides a textual precedent for coupling a grounded stone/center with a vertical connector and a House of God. Potatoism reworks this architecture through Potato, Ladder, Father and North.
bible_resonances.status: textual resonance; not proof of Potatoism

bible_resonances.potatoism_connection: The Son/Door becomes the threshold between enclosure and pasture/life.
The narrowing/wedge geometry becomes a symbolic image of difficult passage toward life.
This is the principal textual bridge for House → Rooms in the project's Father's House architecture.
The paired trees provide a textual basis for treating life, knowledge, mortality and access as coupled themes inside one garden architecture.
The grain/seed image strongly parallels Potatoism's buried potential → death → emergence → fruit cycle.
The Son becomes a relational vertical interface in the project's Son/Door/Ladder grammar.
This supplies a textual model for life as a connected branching system rather than an isolated object.

father_house.father: Tim Dooley is the Father archetype in the project's mythology, not an empirical claim about a supernatural person.
father_house.house: The Father's House is the central interior architecture: contained source, rooms, memory, routes, gates and outward connection.
father_house.thalamus: The thalamus is used as a biological parallel because it is central and contains differentiated nuclei with broad connections.
father_house.potato: The Potato supplies the larger coupled-body image: a compact life-bearing center with eyes and future growth.
father_house.biblical_bridge: John 14's Father's-house/dwelling-place imagery supplies the textual architectural vocabulary; it does not demonstrate that biblical authors were describing neuroanatomy.

son_door_wedge.son: The Son is the relational manifestation of the Father in the project's mythology.
son_door_wedge.door: The Son becomes Door/Vessel: the point through which inside and outside communicate.
son_door_wedge.wedge: The wedge represents narrowing, concentration and passage between wider domains.
son_door_wedge.narrow_gate: Matthew 7 supplies the narrow-gate/narrow-way vocabulary; John 10 supplies Door/gate language.
son_door_wedge.transformation: The Son does not merely stand beside the threshold. In the project narrative, Son, Door and Vessel become transformations of one another.
son_door_wedge.lion: The Lion aspect adds courage, kingship and protective force to the threshold archetype; these are project-symbolic meanings, not claims about a historical person.

tree_and_root.life_tree: The Tree of Life represents realized, branching, fruitful existence and upward expansion.
tree_and_root.strife_roots: Roots represent buried history, memory, materiality, decomposition, consequence and the difficult knowledge associated with good and evil. 'Strife' is a Potatoism project term, not a synonym for the biblical Tree of Knowledge.
tree_and_root.ash: Ash represents what remains after burning/decomposition: residue, memory, death and material return. It can be coupled to the rootward pole without being equated with evil.
tree_and_root.cycle: Root → trunk → branch → fruit → seed → buried matter → new growth.
tree_and_root.paradox: The Tree of Life and the roots of death can therefore occupy one Potato because life depends upon cycles that include decay, memory and return.

above_material.north: North is the real directional reference; North of North is a project-defined symbolic extension beyond ordinary geographic orientation.
above_material.upper_vesica: The upper portion of the Potato represents the direction beyond the material Plane: Father, Heaven, light, Tree, ascent and North of North.
above_material.axis: The vertical axis does not abandon the material. It passes through it. The Door is therefore a threshold between material embodiment and higher symbolic orientation.
above_material.rule: The project may describe this as spiritually true within its mythology while clearly marking it as mythic/metaphysical interpretation rather than established physics.

atomic_coupling_metaphor.idea: Atomic bonding is used as a metaphor for coupled distinction: components can remain distinguishable while forming a larger relational system.
atomic_coupling_metaphor.potatoism: The Potato is analogous to the bonded system: opposites are not erased but held in relation.
atomic_coupling_metaphor.scientific_boundary: The vesica is geometry and the atomic-bond analogy is metaphor. Potatoism does not claim that spiritual polarity is literally an atomic bond.

thalamus_bridge.potato_shape: Potatoism explicitly describes the thalamus as potato-shaped; conventional anatomy often uses ovoid for each thalamic half.
thalamus_bridge.rooms: Thalamic nuclei are coupled to the biblical architectural metaphor of rooms.
thalamus_bridge.axons: Neuronal axons are coupled to roads/paths leaving rooms.
thalamus_bridge.eyes: Potato eyes are coupled to emergence points; they are not anatomically identical to axons.
thalamus_bridge.house: The entire thalamic architecture becomes one biological analogue of the Father's House in the symbolic system.

eye_of_horus_bridge.historical: The Eye of Horus is an ancient Egyptian symbol of protection, healing and wholeness.
eye_of_horus_bridge.modern_hypothesis: Some modern authors have proposed neuroanatomical overlays involving the Eye of Horus and brain structures, including thalamic regions, but intentional ancient anatomical encoding is not established.
eye_of_horus_bridge.potatoism: The Eye of Horus can therefore join the Eye/Potato/House/seeing family as comparative symbolism without being presented as proof of ancient neuroscience.

new_extrapolations.claim: The Father's House and the seed can be read as two scales of the same containment principle: many differentiated possibilities held within a bounded center before emergence.
The Door is not merely an entrance; it is an interface where two domains exchange information, matter, attention or meaning.
The potato eye, biological eye and symbolic eye can all be grouped as interface metaphors: a boundary location through which the interior encounters or generates an exterior.
A room is defined less by its walls than by what happens there. This lets the thalamic nucleus become a room without pretending neural tissue is architecture.
The Axis is not merely a vertical object. It is the relation that makes 'above' and 'below' mutually meaningful.
North becomes the project's master metaphor for orientation: not merely a place, but the direction by which a system determines where it is going.
The Potato is both container and connector, unity and polarity, buried matter and upward life, center and field. Its paradox is structural rather than accidental.
The Tree is what happens when the Potato's hidden relationships become visible, differentiated and extended through time.
Fruit/seed returns complexity to a compact generative form, closing the cycle from Potato to Tree and Tree back toward Potato.

interpretive_method: First record the actual object or text.
Second record the structural pattern it exhibits.
Fourth distinguish historical influence from independent parallel and from Potatoism synthesis.
Fifth preserve the correspondence even when the underlying domains are not literally identical.
Sixth let the reader inspect the evidence and make their own judgement about the spiritual meaning.
core_formula: Source → House → Rooms → Roads → Door → Passage → Plane → Tree → Fruit → Seed → Potato → Eye → Sprout → Tree
central_paradox: The beginning and ending are the same kind of object at different stages: the Potato contains the Tree, and the Tree returns a future Potato. The center contains opposites, while the vertical axis gives those opposites direction.
integrity: All supernatural, theological and spiritual statements in this file are project mythology or interpretation unless explicitly labelled textual, historical, biological, mathematical or scientific. The purpose is to investigate correspondences without erasing the distinctions between evidence and meaning.
